meaning:
1) stylus
1a) iron stylus with diamond tip used to write on stone or metal
1b) reed pen used on a roll

elsewhere.note: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
“ ‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us?” But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.
